content_sections.heading: Tripura University Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. F.TU/REG/ADVT-Cont/01/2026/3 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download Tripura University notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: 10th Pass from any recognised Board; Possession of a Valid Commercial Driving License for Light/Medium and Heavy Vehicles issued by the Competent authority having no adverse endorsement; Knowledge of motor mechanism (the candidate should be able to remove minor defects in vehicles); Latest Medical fitness certificate from a Medical Officer of any Govt. Hospital / Govt. Medical Colleges in Tripura stating that the candidate is medically fit to drive Light / Medium / Heavy Vehicles Experience: Experience of driving motor vehicles for at least 5 (five) years in an organization Age limit: Below 32 years (as on date of interview) Age relaxation: Age relaxation shall be admissible as per the rules of the Government of India Other conditions: Valid Commercial Driving License for Light/Medium and Heavy Vehicles with no adverse endorsement Should be able to remove minor defects in vehicles Medical fitness certificate from a Govt. Hospital / Govt. Medical College in Tripura Those working elsewhere must produce a Relieving Certificate from their present employer before joining

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Tripura University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates without original documents are not allowed to appear for the interview Candidates reporting after 11.00 AM are not permitted to attend the interview Canvassing in any form leads to cancellation of candidature

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual for 6 (six) months effective from the date of joining No claim for extension, absorption, regularization or appointment in any post on the basis of this assignment Assignment is purely temporary and may be discontinued at any time without assigning any reason Contract terminated if documents are found fake or information suppressed

rows.event: Last Date for Email Application (17.00 hours)

content_sections.heading: How Will Tripura University Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of applications Document verification on the interview date Evaluation through driving test, knowledge of traffic rules and skill test Interview Report by 10.00 AM on the interview date for document verification Interview date communicated to shortlisted candidates via email only

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self attested scanned copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials Self attested photograph affixed on the form Attested copy of proof of age Self attested copies of mark-sheets Documentary proof for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PwBD Self attested copies of work experience documents

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Tripura University Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill up the prescribed Application Form attached with the notice. Attach self attested scanned copies of all relevant certificates and testimonials. Send the application to [email protected] on or before 25/11/2026 (17.00 hours). Give a correct and active email address; the interview date is communicated by email only.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Bring the filled-in application form, all original documents and a set of self attested copies to the interview TA/DA will not be paid for attending the interview No interim correspondence shall be entertained The University reserves the right to fill or not to fill up the post

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Driver.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Tripura University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 25 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 32 years (as on date of interview). Relaxation: Age relaxation shall be admissible as per the rules of the Government of India.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 21,000 monthly consolidated salary.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: 10th pass from any recognised Board; valid Commercial Driving License for Light/Medium and Heavy Vehicles with no adverse endorsement; knowledge of motor mechanism; at least 5 years' driving experience in an organization; latest medical fitness certificate from a Govt. Hospital / Govt. Medical College in Tripura.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Valid Commercial Driving License for Light/Medium and Heavy Vehicles with no adverse endorsement. Should be able to remove minor defects in vehicles. Medical fitness certificate from a Govt. Hospital / Govt. Medical College in Tripura. Those working elsewhere must produce a Relieving Certificate from their present employer before joining.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates without original documents are not allowed to appear for the interview. Candidates reporting after 11.00 AM are not permitted to attend the interview. Canvassing in any form leads to cancellation of candidature.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applications. Document verification on the interview date. Evaluation through driving test, knowledge of traffic rules and skill test. Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual for 6 (six) months effective from the date of joining. No claim for extension, absorption, regularization or appointment in any post on the basis of this assignment. Assignment is purely temporary and may be discontinued at any time without assigning any reason.
